__prompts__.description: One-line crate description (required for crates.io release)
__prompts__.keywords: crates.io keywords, space-separated (required for crates.io release)
__prompts__.project_url: Repository URL (written to Cargo.toml; the origin remote unless github_setup creates one)
__prompts__.crate_type: Workspace layout (lib = library only, both = add CLI)
__prompts__.python_interop: Python interop (none = no pyo3, extension = Python calls Rust, embedded = Rust calls Python)
__prompts__.github_setup: Create the GitHub repository (private, internal, public, or None)
__prompts__.release_ci: Release workflow (binaries on tag, crates.io publish, pypi wheels, or None)
__prompts__.coding_agent: Coding agent to set up (Claude, Codex, or None)
